sam: Quick follow-up from PM postmortem INC-6112. We're still getting high page churn for the auth-rate-limit service. Suggest a staircase suppression: short initial quiet period, then progressive backoff on re-pages.
nina: Explain staircase? like exponential backoff per fingerprint? :thinking: We need a deterministic route for oncall to know when they'll be paged.
omar: Yeah: e.g., first trigger -> Slack-only for 2m. If same fingerprint resurfaces within 5m -> single pager. If it keeps repeating, increase suppression to 15m, 60m, etc. Also track host fanout separately so broad-impact incidents skip suppression.
sam: Important: preserve at-least-one-page per-owner group. We'll tag alerts with owner_group and ensure the suppression key respects owner_group.
nina: Also propose adding an automatic annotation with "suppression_level" and a link to the incident ticket so oncall can see what happened historically.
omar: Implementation plan: small middleware in alertproxy that maintains a per-fingerprint state machine (levels: 0=none,1=slack,2=pager,3=suppress-long). State transitions based on recent counts + distinct hosts. We'll emit metrics: alerts.suppression.level{level=..}, alerts.paged.count, alerts.suppressed.count.
sam: Can we keep a safety net: if error_rate > absolute_threshold (e.g., >2000 errors/min) immediately page regardless of suppression? we don't want to hide real outages.
nina: Agreed. Also add a deploy-safety rule: when a deploy is in progress for that service, temporarily widen suppression so noisy deploy-related flaps don't wake pagers. But require an override flag for SRE emergencies.
omar: Pseudo-rule to attach to middleware:
```
# middleware checks:
if distinct_hosts >= 6 and rate > host_fanout_threshold:
  deliver = pager
elif absolute_rate > 2000:
  deliver = pager
else:
  state = get_state(fingerprint)
  if state == 0:
    deliver = slack
    set_state(fingerprint,1,ttl=5m)
  elif state == 1:
    deliver = pager
    set_state(fingerprint,2,ttl=15m)
  elif state == 2:
    deliver = suppress
    set_state(fingerprint,3,ttl=60m)
```
alerts-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation this week: nina -> primary, sam -> secondary. Use /incident create to link pages to INC-6112.
sam: Owners + ETAs: omar (middleware + metrics) ETA Fri EOD, nina (runbook + deploy-safety toggle) ETA Mon, sam (audit dashboards + retrospective post) ETA Wed.
omar: I'll post a staging PR that adds the suppression_level annotation and the new metrics. Will include a CLI script to simulate staircase bursts.
nina: After staging validation, rollout plan: canary in eu-west for 48h, look for decreases in pager rate and check alerts.repaged_after_suppression metric. If repaged_after_suppression > 1% we revert.
sam: Action items recap: 1) omar implement middleware + metrics (Fri EOD) 2) nina update runbook + toggle (Mon) 3) sam create dashboard + schedule 72h canary (Wed). Reconvene Fri morning to check staging logs.
